title: A note on the Browder S-spectrum of a bounded quaternionic operator
summary: Let $A$ be a bounded operator on a separable right quaternionic Hilbert space and let $\CA$ be the set of compact operators commuting with $A$. We establish the formula \[ \sigb(A)=\bigcap_{K\in\CA} \sS(A+K), \] a quaternionic analogue of the classical characterization of the complex Browder spectrum. The proof rests on a factorization lemma (Lemma~\ref{lem:fact}), a consequence of the Riesz--Schauder theorem and an ascent/descent argument, and on the characterization $\sigb(A)=\sS(A)\setminus\sd(A)$ in terms of S-eigenvalues of finite type, due to Arzini and Jaatit \cite{AJ26}, for which we…
